note: One warm-up and one timed synthesis per language in each fresh process. Six main treatments use an even-size Williams order; speed order reverses by block. Historical 1.05x check alternates v2/v5-package AB/BA. No timed sample is trimmed. RTF is wall seconds / final audio seconds; loading, hashing and file I/O excluded. All variants use the same current Python runtime. Shared x86 cloud server, not ARM. RSS guard: process tree 480 MB, system reserve 80 MB, sampled every 50 ms; not cgroup enforcement.
